messages:
Nina (AE): Quick ask from BioSyn 12: they want written confirmation that for the POC all inference traffic, control-plane metadata, and KMS keys remain in eu-west-1. They also need a procurement-ready ballpark for 4x A100 reserved for 12 months.
Ravi (Solutions): Clarifying q: is this just data-at-rest/in-transit + keys, or do they require control-plane and telemetry isolation as well?
Nina (AE): They wrote: "No telemetry or routing metadata may leave the EU; keys must be customer-managed and remain in-region."
Tom (Infra): Short technical: our hosted/shared control plane may call global services for orchestration/telemetry. To provide a strict no-exit guarantee we should use Dedicated in eu-west-1 with a private control plane or a Private deployment. VPC peering + BYOK (EU KMS/HSM) covers key residency. Note: enable EU-only monitoring add-on to avoid non-EU telemetry.
Hannah (Legal): We can offer a DPA addendum + EU-only sub-processor carve-out and provide an attestation. Legal sign-off required but we have precedent. I'll prepare a one-page attestation for their security board.
Ravi (Solutions): POC suggestion: Dedicated 4xA100 in eu-west-1, 14-day smoke tests (latency, throughput, KV cache behavior), then move to 12-month reserve if validated. I'll draft runbook and sample config.
Nina (AE): Procurement needs a number today to include in their internal purchase request. Rough monthly committed range for 4x A100?
Tom (Infra): Back-of-envelope: committed 4xA100 in eu-west-1 ~=   ~26k-42k/month depending on SLA and EU-only monitoring add-on. I'll confirm hard numbers with pricing ops.
Ravi (Solutions): Paste-ready paragraph for their security board:
"Redwood will provision a Dedicated inference deployment in eu-west-1 with a private control plane and VPC peering to ensure that inference payloads, control-plane telemetry, and key material remain within EU boundaries. Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) can be used to keep keys in-region. Non-EU sub-processors will be excluded for this deployment and Redwood will provide a DPA addendum and sub-processor manifest; any exceptions will be documented and escalated to legal."
Nina (AE): Can someone drop the canonical links for the EU-only subproc export and the DPA template I should attach?
Hannah (Legal): Internal links: https://redwood.example/subprocessors/latest and https://redwood.example/subprocessors/eu-only-download. DPA template: https://redwood.example/legal/dpa-eu-template.pdf. I'll post the attestation once legal signs.
InfraBot: ticket #9123 created: dedicated-eu-biosyn. ETA: 48-72h to generate deployment template.
Tom (Infra): Operational caveats to note in the board pack: - cross-region auto-failover disabled for this profile - no async analytics export outside EU - EU-only monitoring stack adds ~72h lead time.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min POC kickoff with BioSyn for 09:00 CET tomorrow and include VPN vs VPC peering options.
Hannah (Legal): Drafting attestation now, will post here for review.
Nina (AE): Action items: Ravi  runbook + kickoff; Tom  firm pricing + infra caveats; Hannah  DPA + attestation. I'll send to BioSyn and request their security questionnaire.
Nina (AE): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
